detail.longDescription: Most teams don't stick to one AI tool. Your support team works in Claude, a few people swear by ChatGPT, and your engineers live in Cursor. Until now, each of those tools needed its own Zapier MCP server, with its own apps and skills to set up. Now you can connect all of them to one Zapier MCP server, and they share everything on it.
